title: dForge Seed Data
description: Seed data records for a dForge entity

entityCode.description: Target entity code to insert records into

records.description: Array of records, each record is an object with column_code → value. In demo-data/ a value may be a formula: { "$f": "DATEADD(@yearStart, 42, 'DAY')" }

repeat.description: demo-data/ only: insert every record once per value of @var, from..to inclusive
